headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, Trilegal, A&O Shearman act on Adani Enterprises ₹15,000 crore QIP
sum: Adani Enterprises Limited has raised ₹15,000 crore from a qualified institutional placement of equity shares. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Adani Enterprises on this QIP.
detail: Adani Enterprises Limited has raised ₹15,000 crore from a qualified institutional placement of equity shares. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Adani Enterprises on this QIP. The transaction was led by Devaki Mankad (Partner, Regional Co-Head - Capital Markets - West), with support from Rishav Buxi (Principal Associate), Adwait Deshmukh (Senior Associate); Associates Archit Jain, Arikta Shetty, Janhavi Deshmukh, Harsha Menon, Akshat Sharma and Sajal Soni. Devaki Mankad Trilegal advised the placement agents, SBI Capital Markets Limited, ICICI Securities Limited, IIFL Capital Services Limited and Jefferies India Private Limited, and on this QIP.
